{{Quote|Korriban was wrought by the true-blooded Sith millennia ago.|Lord Abaron|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Abaron''' was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. A member of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith species]], he was present in the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] in [[3643 BBY]]. There, he assigned a promising [[Sith acolyte/Legends|acolyte]] to scan several elevated [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] due to his concerns about them lacking the [[Blood/Legends|blood]] of the original Sith, a trait he deemed necessary. The acolyte completed the task with the results confirming Abaron's worries, so the Sith Lord promised to report them to the Sith's ruling body, the [[Dark Council]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|So. Yet another acolyte stands in the shadow of our Academy. You must consider yourself privileged.|Lord Abaron welcomes an acolyte|<ref name="TOR" />}}
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith species]], Abaron became a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] by<ref name="TOR" /> [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Dates">{{TORcite|type=faction|Empire|Purity|Korriban}} takes place in the Prologue of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', the events of which occured by [[3643 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:TOR dates|here]].</ref> During the later [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a proxy conflict between the Sith Empire and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Abaron was present in the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], and he eventually grew concerned about the dilution of the ancient Sith [[Blood/Legends|blood]] among his fellow [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameDSmechanics}}
Therefore, working as an agent of both the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] and the Empire's ruling [[Dark Council]], Abaron assigned a promising [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]] to scan four of the academy's [[Overseer (Sith)|Overseers]]&mdash;[[Sith Inquisitor]] [[Arzanon]], Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lords]] [[Solence]] and [[Cestus (Overseer)|Cestus]], and Sith Overseer [[Ragate]]&mdash;inside the Sith Academy and in its vicinity. In order to accomplish this task, Abaron provided the acolyte with an ancient [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] that could measure the purity of a nearby target's blood. The acolyte finished the assignment and later returned to Abaron, who concluded that the blood purity was lacking, as he suspected. Abaron then decided he would bring the results to the attention of the Dark Council.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|True purity and strength are carried in the blood.|Lord Abaron|<ref name="TOR" />}}
Abaron was [[Color/Legends|red]]-skinned and had red [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and dark-brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]]. As a descendant of the original Sith [[Species/Legends|species]], Abaron was deeply worried with the dilution of his species' blood within the ranks of the Sith. He thought that those with strong enough heritage&mdash;though not necessarily of the Sith species&mdash;should be uplifted, while the others should be made their [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Abaron first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. He starts and ends the side quest "Purity," which can be taken by players of the [[Sith Warrior]] and Sith Inquisitor classes during the Prologue stage. Although the player may choose to reply between choices for [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light-side]] or [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark-side]] points, the outcome always remains the same.<ref name="TOR" />
